reason_for_change: Adds a recurring 5/5 flying Demon token each end step and card draw when attacking with Demons. The token itself creates a 5-damage Be'lakor trigger when Be'lakor is present; the enchantment's own Demon entry has no power and therefore deals 0 damage through that trigger.
commander_identity_impact: Kindred enchantment with Demon subtype increases Demon count for Be’lakor’s draw ability; token production directly fuels the commander’s damage trigger.
optimization_tradeoff: Trades a conditional end-step non-Demon removal engine for recurring tokens, card draw and a stronger go-wide plan.
verification_gate_status: PASS — Oracle/type/power/identity/Commander legality checked; rules interaction explicitly verified.
notes: The Covenant may sacrifice itself if the two cards milled share exactly the same combination of card types; subtype/supertype do not count.

reason_for_change: Six-mana flying Demon with morbid removal at each end step when a creature died that turn. Powerful but conditional and its trigger is mandatory; cut to add a more consistent Demon token/card-draw engine.
commander_identity_impact: Removes one Demon body and conditional removal source.
optimization_tradeoff: Reduces conditional control; improves long-game value and repeated Demon ETB trigger production.
notes: Cut is a tradeoff, not a claim that Reaper is weak in every board state.

reason_for_change: Eight-mana creature that grants all Demons menace, lifelink and haste, then creates a 5/5 black Demon token copying a creature card in a graveyard at the beginning of combat. This gives recurring Demon ETBs and can copy ETB text. Cost reducers and Sneak Attack help mitigate the high printed cost.
commander_identity_impact: Ardyn is not a Demon, but substantially upgrades the Demon board and generates a Demon token every combat when a graveyard target exists.
optimization_tradeoff: Trades opponent creature-count suppression for proactive token generation, evasion, haste and lifelink; adds an eight-mana card but multiple cost-cheat effects are already present.
verification_gate_status: PASS — Oracle, color identity, Commander legality and graveyard-copy/ETB interaction checked.
notes: The token copies the target card’s copiable values/abilities, with the specified 5/5 black Demon modifications; its ETB abilities trigger.

reason_for_change: Five-mana 5/4 flyer that limits each opponent to at most two creatures at their end step. This is powerful board control, but it does not add value when Demons enter and is less proactive than the selected Demon-token/keyword engine.
commander_identity_impact: Removes a Demon and an oppressive board-control effect.
optimization_tradeoff: Gives up creature-count suppression for recurring token/ETB value and teamwide keywords.
notes: Acknowledge this is a power/role tradeoff; Archfiend remains excellent against creature-heavy tables.
